section_summary.extract_value: This section (3.2.1) presents factor analysis results for a female-only sample (n = 171). The analysis revealed one factor with an eigenvalue of 5.99 explaining 59.90% of variance, with factor loadings ranging from .62 to .83 and adequate internal consistency (Cronbach's α = .94). The KMO measure (.94) and Bartlett's test (p < .001) confirmed sampling adequacy.
